mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.shop_id, v.created_by, v.product_id, v.title, v.sub_title, v.rules, v.pay_value, v.actual_value, v.type, v.status, sv.stock, sv.begin_time, sv.end_time FROM tb_voucher v JOIN tb_shop s ON s.id = v.shop_id LEFT JOIN tb_seckill_voucher sv ON sv.voucher_id = v.id WHERE v.shop_id = #{shopId} AND s.business_status = 1 AND v.status = 1
